items.title: Gene Bertoncini interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: And Wayne called me about a couple of months after the record had been out. He said, “Gene, I love what you did on the CD, so I’m putting this little group together.

ctx.x: I said what am I getting into here? And I go in and I see three percussionists. I think it was Billy Hart, Alphonse Mouzon and then some Italian guy who’s name I forget. And there were two bass players I think, Ron and Cecil McBee. And Dave Friedman on vibes. And I forget, it might have been — I don’t know who the piano player was. And Wayne starts explaining his charts. He says “I want this to feel like the wind here, and this thing here—” they were sketchy kind of things. And there was enough music to read and…
